_about: Which VAT rate level each EU country applies to a kind of goods (a catalog tax category). A level is one of standard, reduced, reduced_alt, super_reduced, zero; its rate per country comes from the world-tax crate's table. A country missing from a category is taxed at its standard rate. Drawn from the European Commission's 'VAT rates applied in the Member States' (2025): food is basic foodstuffs, medicines are sold without prescription, press is newspapers and periodicals. Have an accountant review it before relying on it: rates and their scope change. The effective rates are tabled in docs/invoicing.md (a test keeps the table current).

_review.reviewed_by: Claude Code, against the Commission's 'VAT rates applied in the Member States' (January 2025) and the national changes of 2025 and 2026 (EE, CZ, LV, LT, SK, RO, FI); not a professional opinion
changed: EE books: reduced (13 %) -> reduced_alt (9 %); 13 % is the accommodation rate
CZ press: zero -> reduced (12 %); only books are zero-rated since 2024
to_confirm: LV books, press: 5 % in law since 2025-12-18, 12 % here (world-tax has no 5 % level for LV)
LT press: the 9 % band was abolished on 2026-01-01 and periodicals are not named in the 5 % band
BE press: daily and weekly newspapers are 0 %, other periodicals 6 %
ES, IT food: basic foodstuffs are 4 %, other food 10 %
